notes.title: July Update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/6db42ea9dba888fdd6928d0b206d2c262602833e.png"]
SPoOoOoOKinEsS IN JULY?!?!


That's right! A new HANGMAN update is here :D



Our resident programmer, Wilder, worked on updating quite a few things in the game! (We promise this was of his own accord---we do NOT have him chained to a desk, we swear o.O) 


Build V3.4 Updates
This latest update includes...

An options button in the Main Menu

Fullscreen and Windowed options for both the Main Menu and Pause Menu

Random Word Mode is now more noticeable

In Random Word Mode, the full word is now revealed at the end of each round, regardless of loss or win

20 more words in Random Word Mode! (Word Pack #2)

Update to the profanity filter

Slightly faster movement speed in Random Word Mode

Subtle audio indication of secret level entrance location

'Locked gate' sound if the secret level entrance is approached after losing all limbs


More achievements :D


On top of all these updates in the build, we also have brand new achievements!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/2c072338d9a72a80419c4dca60261582017e65e8.png"]

Are you able to unlock them all?!


...and more to come.


Keep an eye out for any future updates or patches for the game! As well as new PiPo releases 👀



If you'd like to keep up to date with our other projects, feel free to join the Discord server and donate to our Ko-Fi if you'd like to support us!



Happy spelling ;)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/e3568c444489700e53c1271db88dc2cb5ed9b2ce.png"]

notes.title: Post-Halloween Treat!
notes.content:
Happy November everybody!

Hope it's been treating you well and we hope you had a great Halloween last week!

Our team celebrated with a little Ladtholomew (the name of our player character, of course) and Pixel Poxet-themed cake during our Halloween party :D

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/f20deb5d3890cf13fbd91e211d8b2a784dcb3c3e.jpg

We're also super excited to announce that we've been featured in an article by Games Ardor! 
Read it now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/7f3f74df34658c9c709fcc49bcba82e2a2ae037a.png

After taking some time to rest from all the excitement of the spooky season, we're happy to announce that we've made some updates to the game!

Steam Achievements have arrived!

If you haven't noticed yet, we finally added a few Steam Achievements to the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/41c90a2a3f498c52d6ae6a4df23a9d33f856bfcf.png

There are seven total and we plan to add more in the future. Try and get them all... if you dare.

More Words for Random Mode!

As stated, we've included 25 new words in our Random Mode! Think you can get them right?

Volume Button

A volume button has been included in the pause menu, so you can control just how scared you want to get from those jumpscares (;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/9ee8d30443127c932ae8f6626b3241c0810aa8d0.png

This allows you to adjust the volume levels and mute the game if desired.

New Sounds and Indicators

New sounds have been added to the game, as well as indicators!

We've gotten some contradicting feedback about the difficulty of the secret level and realized it may help the player to know that they gain speed every time they get a letter wrong. Players who are slow say it's very difficult, but players who have discovered the strategy to gain speed find running from the hands easy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/cd9114c65348792121f8690eef0919519f3927a0.png

With that in mind, we've added a speed indicator that pops up every time the player gets a letter wrong. We may still tweak the secret level according to feedback.

Updated Credits - Super Special Thanks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/16be6db7271658aaa4684856f058cdf66e9013c4.png

Included a special thanks section to our credits for our supporters and collaborators!

...and some minor fixes (:

Thank you all for the lovely feedback and support!

Be sure to check out and wishlist our other game in the meantime, Paper Trails: A Scrapbooking Story <3

Happy gaming!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/e3568c444489700e53c1271db88dc2cb5ed9b2ce.png
